prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a breathtaking luxury fashion magazine cover. Place the large bold silver serif brand name SOLÈNE elegantly at the very top of the frame, slightly transparent and overlapping the model's hair like a high-end fashion magazine masthead. Use a clean cream-white seamless studio background with soft warm-toned lighting. Center an adult white fashion model with soft angelic facial features, luminous natural skin, dreamy green eyes with long lashes and long silky chocolate-brown wavy hair cascading freely over both shoulders. She sits gracefully with her upper body leaning slightly forward, one arm resting on her knee and the other hand delicately touching her jaw, gazing slightly upward and off-camera with a soft mysterious expression. She wears a dramatic floor-length dusty rose blush satin ballgown with exaggerated sculptural puff shoulders that billow outward like rose petals. The bodice is opaque champagne silk mesh with tiny pearl and crystal details, fitted through the waist and blooming into an enormous tiered skirt pooling around her. Let the fabric catch the light with a soft luminous sheen. Add the supplied magazine text naturally: SOFT & SOVEREIGN / THE NEW ERA OF BEAUTY on the left, LUMINOUS & RARE / PURE GRACE on the right, and DIVINE & UNTOUCHABLE at the bottom. Vertical 9:13 format, ultra-photorealistic, 8K and cinematic color grading. Preserve the supplied couture silhouette, pose, masthead and cover hierarchy.
